source.acquisition: Complete source file read and parsed as text; no donor imports or execution
source.function_hash_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 ast.get_source_segment function definition after CRLF-to-LF normalization, without trailing newline

target.runtime: Self-contained Python standard-library module, included verbatim in deterministic agent packages
target.package_integrity: Existing manifest bindings, runtime reconstruction, outcome validation and build attestation

preserved_behavior: Extract explicit quantity/unit tokens from plans and specifications text.
Normalize SF, GSF, sqft, sq ft and sq. ft to SF; TONS to TON; retain CY, CF, LF, EA, GAL and LBS.
Find a governing CSI section or Division heading on the quantity line or preceding eleven lines.
Retain the first source for duplicate quantity lines and group quantities by division and unit.
Return line items, division totals and an area total in square feet.
reconciliations: Input accepts only bounded plans_text and specs_text strings; scope_manifest, precomputed areas and area_total_sf cannot bypass source extraction.
Plans and specifications use separate heading scopes, preventing a plans heading from assigning a specifications quantity.
Source evidence records input field, one-based line, zero-based half-open character offsets and the exact matched token; the display snippet remains bounded to 140 characters.

Reject nonpositive quantities, malformed thousands separators, scientific notation fragments, obvious ranges, word-embedded fragments and nonfinite numeric conversions; leading decimal quantities retain their true value.
A six-digit number immediately followed by a recognized quantity unit is not promoted as its own CSI heading.
Deduplication compares exact numeric quantity and the complete source line instead of two-decimal rounding and a forty-character prefix, preventing distinct source quantities from collapsing.
At most 1000 line items are retained. line_count and all totals describe only returned line items. Additional distinct positive quantities set truncated=true and never silently inflate totals.
Reject any candidate whose addition would overflow a division total or the square-foot total; excluded_quantities counts recognized candidates rejected by numeric or lexical checks.
Lookup work uses source line iteration and an eighty-character prefix window rather than repeatedly scanning the entire document prefix.
Balanced and precision use the same deterministic quantity extraction behavior; no artificial accuracy distinction or market-quality metric is introduced.

contract.empty_and_zero_behavior: Return no extracted items, zero totals and line_count=0; never synthesize a positive quantity.

authority.execution: Existing OrchestrationManager invokes the registered pure capability under the existing mission authority envelope.
authority.persistence: Existing CommitService records mission, validation, publication and execution provenance; the quantity handler performs no durable mutations.

coverage: Fixed source quantities and source spans
acceptance.evidence_limit: Deterministic explicit text extraction and fixed expected outcomes only; this does not establish drawing takeoff accuracy, prices, industry superiority or production estimating completeness.
